name: Illusion
introduce:
HU-41E 幻惑
联合设计局全新研发的轻型机兵，目前仍处于实战验证阶段，尚未成规模列装。
该机型完全采用奥维特技术打造，不仅拥有独特的外形，其内部的钢岚合金框架、模块连接结构、动力单元乃至主控系统更是与米赫玛岛上的其他机兵有着不小的差别。这种非常规的设计使得HU-41E拥有优秀的基础性能，且可实现非常规的武装搭配，但这同时也意味着只有足够优秀的整备员与机师才能发挥其真正的作战能力。

30518.name: Adaptive Energy Mod
30518.SpecificEffects:
Repair AMT increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>. When actively using repair skills, Repair AMT additionally increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>；
After using non-attack command skills, next active attack skill AP cost reduces by <color=#F74848>-1</color>. After using active attack skills, next active non-attack command skills AP cost reduces by <color=#F74848>-1</color>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

20604.name: Wayward Engine
20604.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>1</color> target affected by repair effect, <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> or Splash DMG from this unit, increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>6%</color> and Repair AMT by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, stacking up to <color=#F74848>5</color> times, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.
